name: sheets-mcp
description: A local Google Sheets MCP server built for agent workflows in Claude Code and Claude Desktop: write API, script and file output into sheets, combine spreadsheets, refresh them on a schedule, across multiple Google accounts. Undo and formula-error checks on every write.

paragraphs: The power tool for Google Sheets in Claude. A free, open-source MCP server that connects your spreadsheets to everything Claude Desktop and Claude Code can do: pull data from APIs and files into a sheet, build new sheets from your other sheets, keep them updated on a schedule, and work across several Google accounts. Formulas, formatting, charts and pivot tables included, with undo and formula-error checks on every write. It runs on your computer and talks to Google directly.
Free and open source · Runs on your computer · Spreadsheet-only Google access · Claude Desktop and Claude Code
If Sheets MCP saves you time, a ⭐ on GitHub helps other people find it.
